Messages.Author: TONY RICARDI
Messages.Body:
-> I have never seen a succubus club, or even heard of one. I just
-> looked at Shane Travis' spoiler list, and the card text makes NO
-> SENSE. Does the card grant you the power to say to another
-> Mesuthelah " I'll give you 3 pool and a Burning Wrath for your Archon
-> Investigation."? From your HAND? And then there is the phrase "none
-> are enforced by the rules" (Sorry I haven't posted card text but
-> cheesy shell and DOS vs UNIX makes it tough) Does this mean that,
-> after saying the above, I can proceed to give the other person a
-> Chainsaw? And they can give me a Movement of the Mind? It just
-> seems too wierd. Tell me I have it all wrong please. And what makes
-> winning inevitable with 2 at one table?

Yes, all that is true; you may trade cards in play, cards in hand,
equipment, pool, vampires, anything.

The best use for Succubus Club is in a political deck. A while back I
posted how I call a Rumors of Gehenna vote, then offered to include
anyone who gave me 2 pool. Result; 8 pool. One trick I have not been
able to do yet is call Praxis: Solomon on 2 other Methuselahs, then have
them bid on who gets to keep the contested vampire!

The reason it was banned in tounaments for a while is, occasionally
people would get together beforehand and agree for one to give ALL their
pool and vampires to the other; the second player would easily win and
they would split the prize. If the Club is off the banned list,
hopefully they have simply made a rule against this abuse.
